author: CNET
description:
We've hit 451K continuous folds on the iPhone Duo and finally seeing some some signs of wear! Watch for more progress on CNET's YouTube at 1pm EST to 5pm EST.

Apple has not publicly stated the anticipated number of folds the iPhone Duo would endure, so we’ve been left to speculate. Guesses within CNET have ranged from 500,000 (matching Samsung’s rating for the Galaxy Z Fold 8) to 1.5 million.

We are going to keep going. And we hope you’ll stick with us, both here and on our daily livestreams, to see what more unfolds. #foldaphone #iPhoneDuo #apple #Durability #AllthingsMobile
